tool_input.command: export CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="/private/tmp/claude-501/pr86-ci-live/lt/runs/sysspec112/fx" && cd -- "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && [ "$(pwd -P)" = "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" ] && H=plugins/system-spec-harness && S=$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/system-spec && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -B $H/scripts/validate-coverage-matrix.py --matrix $S/spec-state.json --require-complete --require-basis --require-foundation; echo cov=$?; PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -B $H/scripts/validate-source-citation.py --targets $S/spec-state.json --references $S/fetched-references.json --state $S/spec-state.json --repo-root $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR; echo cit=$?; PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -B $H/skills/assign-system-spec-completeness-evaluator/scripts/aggregate-completeness.py --help 2>&1 | head -30

  --knowledge-graph     C13-C16 の 4 profile gate を実行
  --spec-dir SPEC_DIR   --report と併用。report の spec_dir がこの dir に解決するかも検証する
  --hearing HEARING     C06 (hearing-auditor) の出力 JSON。--state と併用し sub-input
                        判定を導く
  --state STATE         --hearing / --source-citation が読む spec-state.json
